summary: Frontend verification for /industries showcase page (bug-fix for 'I can't find the new designs'). Tested route rendering, discoverability from dashboard + landing, live-preview reactivity (industry/accent/base-template/opacity/device toggle), CTAs, mobile layout, and /:slug regression. 13/13 critical tests pass. One minor cosmetic issue: ~6px horizontal overflow on mobile (390px) caused by phone-frame preview.

issues: Minor horizontal overflow (~6px, scrollWidth=396 vs clientWidth=390). Root cause: the mobile phone-frame preview uses `w-full max-w-[390px] border-4` inside a `px-4` section. The 8px border + w-full pushes the .order-1 column to width=380 starting at x=16, extending to right=396. Suggested fix: reduce phone frame width (e.g. max-w-[358px] on mobile) OR wrap preview in a container with overflow-x-hidden, OR remove border-4 on mobile.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Fix 6px horizontal overflow on /industries at 390px viewport (phone frame + border-4 vs section px-4).
